scope: Private source/provenance ledger, not inference labels or automatic data admission

recordFields.id: Stable source ID plus one-based block index; bound to the attested whole-file hash
recordFields.sourcePath: Repository-relative private original; never substitute a generated view
recordFields.sourceLocator: One-based inclusive startLine/endLine; zero-based, end-exclusive Unicode startChar/endChar after utf-8-sig decoding
recordFields.normalizedSha256: Whitespace/NFKC/digit/case normalized hash, private; does not establish ancestry
recordFields.origin: User-attested real seed, known generated artifact, or unresolved; never inferred from a bank filename
recordFields.originVerification: What establishes the claim; user statement is not bank authentication
recordFields.sender: Actual envelope sender or null; do not synthesize it from provider/file names
recordFields.receivedAt: Actual envelope time or null; transaction time in the text is not collection time
recordFields.templateProxyId: Heuristic fingerprint, never a verified source-template family
recordFields.parentRecordIds: Confirmed parents or null when untraceable; do not convert similarity into ancestry
recordFields.sanitizedTextDraft: Private redaction draft; preserve financial values and useful context
recordFields.redactions: Original and sanitized character spans plus placeholder type; no raw sensitive values copied into metadata
recordFields.sanitizationReviewStatus: Draft versus reviewed status; automatic replacement does not certify anonymization
recordFields.labels: Null until explicitly annotated and reviewed, with reviewer/origin per field
recordFields.trainingEligible: False until development admission gates pass
recordFields.evaluationEligible: False for development-exposed seeds and descendants, even after sanitization

privacy: Store all record-level output under ignored data/private/. Public reports contain aggregate counts and methods only.
